ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Childcare Program
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's childcare program and follow the money to determine where the $9B in lost funds went.
questions: Where did the $9B in lost funds go?
Who is responsible for the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and hold those responsible accountable. I will use financial records and interviews with key stakeholders to follow the money and determine where the lost funds went.
